📺 Grey’s Anatomy (2005–Present)

Grey’s Anatomy follows Meredith Grey and a dedicated team of surgeons as they navigate the intense and unpredictable world of medicine at Seattle’s Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital. From complicated surgeries and life-threatening emergencies to unexpected romances, heartbreaking losses, and personal struggles, the doctors face challenges that test their skills and emotional strength. As friendships grow and relationships change, they must balance their demanding careers with their personal lives while making difficult decisions that can mean the difference between life and death. Combining powerful medical stories, unforgettable characters, emotional moments, and dramatic twists, the series explores love, friendship, sacrifice, resilience, and the extraordinary dedication of healthcare professionals.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Romance • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~43 minutes per episode • 23rd season premiered in 2026

🎥 Creator: Shonda Rhimes

🏆 Recognition: Starring Ellen Pompeo, Chandra Wilson, and James Pickens Jr., the series has won multiple Primetime Emmy Awards and Golden Globe Awards, including Best Television Series – Drama. It is one of the longest-running medical dramas in television history.

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu • Netflix (select seasons and regions) • ABC • Disney+ (select regions). Availability varies by region.
